review.notes: Full re-review. All four findings of the previous review are repaired. Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry as the only warning; one-tactic probe closes none of the 44 theorems; dependency check 0 problems; pinned Mathlib and Tau Ceti searched by object, no duplicate.
